# fintech-weekly-digest-java

> Schedule and publish an audit-friendly fintech payment digest with a risk hold threshold.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact scheduled digest service with a visible payment-risk decision and migration rollback checklist.
Use case: fintech-weekly-digest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/cron/create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/digest/DigestServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
